**Clinical Summary:**  
A 1-month-old, asymptomatic, pink, exophytic forehead nodule with central keratin-filled invagination was biopsied. A *single* lesion — even if ultimately confirmed as BCC — does not establish Gorlin syndrome; it only *raises suspicion*.
